mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, aggressive monetary tightening reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS increase > 0.5% in 3 months) signals labor market recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months
regime_hint: high unemployment with labor force expansion
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 1.5% signals robust economic activity, supporting positive equity valuations and producing S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 210.0 and decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% signals central bank response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0 and HOUST < 550.0), simultaneous declines in manufacturing output and housing activity signal broad economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and HOUST < 550.0.
